title: Salesforce OEM Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD


We are seeking an experienced Salesforce OEM Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce-based products using Salesforce’s OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) platform. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce application development, second-generation managed packages, and modern Salesforce development practices, including a thorough and practical understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits and how to design within them.


Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

  • Write comprehensive unit tests to ensure high code coverage and validate behavior under governor limit constraints
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex performance and limit-related issues across customer environments
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Salesforce OEM best practice guidelines


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience developing on the Salesforce Platform, particularly with hands-on experience with Salesforce OEM development.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
  • Thorough understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits, including how they impact:

○Apex execution

○Flows and declarative automation

○Bulk processing and data volume

○Multi-tenant OEM applications

  • Deep Salesforce administrator-level expertise, including:

○Flow and declarative automation tooling

○Security and permissions modeling

○Page layouts and Lightning Record Pages

○Data modeling and configuration best practices

  • Experience using Git for source control in collaborative development environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data access patterns, and scalable design principles
  • Hold a Platform App Builder Certification is a valuable plus!


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build and scale advanced Salesforce OEM products that power multi-tenant enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Events & Client Support

• Present and organize vendor quotes (venues, invitations, catering, promotional items)

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in a support role such as Executive Assistant, Operations, or Marketing

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Essential Skills

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for HungerRush Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all HungerRush Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls

issues

  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

title: Desenvolvedor(a) IOS Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) iOS para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicativos mobile para o ecossistema Apple. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir novas funcionalidades, evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações e garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade do código .


Buscamos alguém com boa autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade do código e que goste de colaborar com times multidisciplinares.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos iOS utilizando Swift
  • Escrever código limpo, organizado e de fácil manutenção
  • Traduzir protótipos e designs em interfaces funcionais e bem estruturadas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com designers, desenvolvedores backend e outros membros do time
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e contribuir para evolução da arquitetura das aplicações
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs e problemas de performance
  • Realizar integração com APIs e serviços backend
  • Acompanhar tendências e boas práticas do ecossistema iOS


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Domínio da linguagem Swift
  • Domínio de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO)
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces utilizando Auto Layout e Interface Builder (Storyboards e XIBs)
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura MVVM
  • Familiaridade com design patterns como Delegate, Notification e Injeção de Dependências
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências utilizando CocoaPods
  • Conhecimento dos frameworks nativos da Apple e das Human Interface Guidelines
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful e manipulação de JSON
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git (Gitflow)
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Experiência com publicação e gerenciamento de aplicativos na App Store
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de software mobile
  • Experiência com automação de testes para aplicações mobile
  • Experiência com Firebase
  • Experiência com integração com APIs e SDKs nativos do iOS


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: SR Desenvolvimento React Native + IA
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;

  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco

title: Senior Salesforce Admin
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Admin

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration : 6 Months

Need to support PST hours

Level: Salesforce Administrator or higher

Salesforce Certified Administrator – required

About the Role

CriticalRiver’s Salesforce Studio is seeking a Salesforce Admin / Support Analyst to provide day-to-day support for our GTM (Go-to-Market) systems team. This role will focus on managing support requests, enabling end users, and partnering with developers to ensure smooth delivery of enhancements and projects. The ideal candidate has strong Salesforce administration skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience working in fast-paced, Agile environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the first line of support for Salesforce GTM systems users, addressing tickets and troubleshooting issues.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into well-defined user stories for the development team.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA, and business stakeholders to support the delivery of enhancements and fixes.
  • Coordinate and facilitate demos, UAT sessions, and enablement activities to ensure smooth adoption of new functionality.
  • Manage Salesforce configuration, including user management, profiles, roles, page layouts, validation rules, and automation (Flows).
  • Provide documentation and training materials to support ongoing user adoption.
  • Monitor Salesforce platform releases and recommend improvements.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Salesforce administration experience supporting business teams.
  • Strong skills in Salesforce configuration (users, roles, profiles, page layouts, validation rules, flows).
  • Experience writing and managing user stories in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
  • Strong coordination and facilitation skills (demos, enablement, UAT).
  • Excellent communication skills in English with the ability to interact with end users and technical teams.
  • Nearshore availability (LATAM strongly preferred).
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator – required.
  • Additional Salesforce certifications (e.g., Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder) are a plus.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para soluções digitais modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a dados, dentro de um ambiente global e colaborativo.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Entendimento sólido de versionamento com GitHub .
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .
  • Capacidade de aplicar conceitos básicos de dados/analytics para enriquecer funcionalidades.
  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.


About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.


Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.


Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.


Interested in joining Keeta?

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Archer System Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um(a) System Engineer Sênior com experiência em ARCHER e ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS) , para atuar no planejamento, engenharia e sustentação da infraestrutura de sistemas da organização.

O(a) profissional será responsável por upgrades, versionamentos, rotinas de manutenção e por garantir a estabilidade, performance e evolução dos ambientes tecnológicos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Archer IT Controls Engineer dentro do modelo de governança de risk management.
  • Realizar manutenções, ajustes e criação de novos módulos dentro da plataforma Archer.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de tecnologia e governança.
  • Trabalhar com alto nível de autonomia e organização.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (principalmente AWS) e apoiar rotinas de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento avançado em RSA Archer (criação, customização e manutenção de módulos).
  • Forte background de infraestrutura .
  • AWS – indispensável (principal ambiente utilizado).
  • Azure – conhecimento desejável .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos de sistemas, redes e comunicação.
  • Vivência com upgrades, versionamento e rotinas de manutenção.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas corporativas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de desenvolvimento e CI/CD (GitHub, PowerShell, JavaScript, .NET ) e com gestão de mudanças (ITIL) .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Senior AI Engineer – Developer Productivity & AI in SDLC
description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais Senior AI Engineer – Developer Productivity & AI in SDLC para apoiar a construção e operacionalização do modelo de uso de Inteligência Artificial dentro do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) .

Você atuará próximos da liderança de engenharia, ajudando a transformar estratégia em execução prática, estruturando padrões, playbooks e fluxos operacionais que permitam escalar o uso de IA entre squads de desenvolvimento.

Nosso foco está em engenharia aplicada, produtividade, adoção real e escala dentro do ambiente de desenvolvimento .

Se você gosta de transformar ideias em frameworks operacionais que funcionam no dia a dia das squads , essa oportunidade pode ser para você.


Missão da função

Apoiar a implementação do modelo operacional de uso de IA no SDLC , estruturando e executando iniciativas relacionadas a:

  • Uso de IA nas etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento
  • Melhoria da produtividade de engenharia
  • Criação de padrões, playbooks e frameworks internos
  • Enablement de squads de engenharia
  • Governança prática do uso de IA

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

title: Template Designer Intern
description:
Na Cape.io, não estamos apenas acompanhando o ritmo da indústria publicitária. Estamos acelerando-o.


Somos uma empresa global de tecnologia com a missão de eliminar o atrito entre o criativo e a mídia. A Cape.io é a primeira plataforma de Automação Inteligente de Campanhas a unificar todo o ciclo de vida de uma campanha. Ao integrar IA e conformidade (compliance) automatizada desde a concepção criativa até a ativação, capacitamos marcas a lançar campanhas de alto impacto e dentro das normas com velocidade e inteligência sem precedentes.


Nossa plataforma conta com a confiança das principais agências e anunciantes do mundo para controlar e distribuir conteúdo publicitário em mais de 100 países. Com mais de 230 funcionários em 21 escritórios — de Londres às Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico — estamos mudando fundamentalmente a forma como a publicidade funciona.


O que você fará

Como Estagiário(a) de Template Design, você ajudará a criar e otimizar templates para clientes. Você participará de projetos de onboarding criativo e auxiliará no treinamento de novos clientes que utilizam nossa ferramenta self-service de Template Designer. Além disso, você será um ponto de contato para suporte e dúvidas técnicas sobre a ferramenta.

Durante seu estágio, você aprenderá:


  • Como construir templates dinâmicos para diversos clientes globais.
  • Como guiar novos clientes através do processo de onboarding criativo.
  • Como fornecer treinamento especializado e suporte técnico sobre nossa ferramenta de design.


O que você traz (Perfil desejado)

  • Formação: Você está cursando ensino superior ou se formou recentemente em áreas correlatas (Design, Publicidade, Marketing,, etc.).
  • Experiência em Design: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Photoshop, InDesign, Figma ou softwares similares.
  • Familiarizado com Automação: Você gosta de otimizar processos e torná-los mais eficientes através da tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Você gosta de interagir com pessoas, dar treinamentos e solucionar dúvidas de clientes.
  • Idiomas: Português nativo e proficiência em Inglês e Espanhol.
  • Atenção aos detalhes: Você tem um olhar apurado para design e garante que todos os templates tenham acabamento profissional.
  • Vontade de crescer: Mentalidade curiosa e motivação para desenvolver novas habilidades técnicas e de atendimento ao cliente.


Sobre nossa solução de automação criativa

  • O desafio: Gargalos criativos e operações manuais de Ad Ops geram sobrecarga nas equipes e prejudicam a performance das campanhas. O ciclo infinito de revisões impede que as marcas escalem o que realmente funciona.
  • Nossa solução: Construímos uma plataforma all-in-one para produzir, personalizar e lançar anúncios de alta performance em todos os canais — de redes sociais e display a vídeo e DOOH. Unificamos os fluxos de criação e mídia, permitindo que marcas passem de um único criativo mestre para variações ilimitadas em minutos.
  • Seu impacto: Você estará no coração da nossa missão de libertar a criatividade. Você capacitará nossos clientes a superar a concorrência através de ferramentas que transformam dados em anúncios personalizados de alto impacto em escala.


Nosso DNA: Como trabalhamos

Nossos valores são os princípios que guiam nossas decisões e interações todos os dias:

  • Mova-se com inteligência (Move smart): A hesitação mata o ritmo. Combinamos velocidade com inteligência, transformando desafios complexos em soluções automatizadas.
  • Defina o amanhã (Define tomorrow): Não estamos aqui para atender expectativas, mas para redefini-las. Buscamos qualidade, segurança e escala sem precedentes.
  • Melhores juntos (Be better together): O sucesso se multiplica quando compartilhado. Através da colaboração aberta e apoio mútuo, transformamos potencial individual em conquista coletiva.
  • Mude o que é possível (Change what’s possible): A criatividade impulsiona a humanidade. Nossa tecnologia existe para amplificá-la e permitir que ela decole.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver aplicações web full stack utilizando combinações de .NET Core , C# , Node.js , React , Angular ou Vue .
  • Criar e integrar APIs RESTful , garantindo segurança, estabilidade e alta performance.
  • Construir funcionalidades robustas no front-end utilizando frameworks JavaScript modernos.
  • Trabalhar com Azure Web Apps , Azure SQL , Azure Functions e API Management para desenvolver soluções em nuvem escaláveis e seguras.
  • Colaborar em um ambiente Agile/Scrum , participando de refinamentos, plannings, reviews e cerimônias de time.
  • Utilizar GitHub para versionamento, code reviews, integração contínua e boas práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, debugging e otimizações de aplicações em ambiente de produção.
  • Implementar práticas de secure coding , garantindo conformidade, segurança e confiabilidade do software.
  • Aplicar habilidades analíticas em automações, manipulação de dados ou geração de insights quando necessário.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software full stack.
  • Experiência prática com:
  • .NET Core e C#
  • Pelo menos um framework front-end moderno (React , Angular , Vue )
  • Node.js para serviços backend ou full stack com Vue
  • Experiência construindo e consumindo APIs REST .
  • Familiaridade com Azure SQL , Azure Web Apps e práticas de desenvolvimento em nuvem.

  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e participação em times Scrum .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de secure coding .
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Python para analytics, automações ou utilitários backend.
  • Vivência com Azure API Management ou práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de trabalho ágil, como Azure DevOps (ADO) .

  • Experiência com consultas OData (especialmente em ADO ou outras APIs).


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Refunds Specialist
description:
ROLE

Property Leads is a fast-growing startup building cutting-edge lead generation and data solutions for the real estate industry. We're a lean, high-impact team of 20, solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and growth.


We’re looking for an exceptional communicator and lead prospector capable of achieving remarkable results in the Refunds Specialist role at Property Leads. The successful candidate in this role must know that this is not a traditional 9 am to 5 pm job– evening and weekend work are required, and 40-60 hours per week are required.


You’ll work closely with our Senior Refund Coordinator and Customer Success Manager to collect data through text, phone calls, and email communication to process refunds accurately and efficiently.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm the status of selling their home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to determine if they own the home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm if a mobile home for sale does/does not come with the land it sits on.
  • Move all prospects to the proper pipeline stage via CRM throughout the day.
  • Maintain a clear, up-to-date, and accurate pipeline in our CRM.
  • Follow up diligently and consistently with sellers over extended periods.
  • Document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM's “notes” section, escalating to Support or the Senior Refunds Coordinator as needed.
  • Process refunds with integrity, according to the refund policy.


RESULTS

  • Reach sellers promptly to help determine the outcome of declining/approving a refund request.
  • All sellers are promptly followed up with.
  • There is an effective line of communication between this role and the Senior Refunds Coordinator in which all necessary information is communicated promptly.
  • Continuously improve communication skills (Crucial Conversations book, etc.)
  • All internal communication cycles are adequately followed.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven work experience with cold calling or phone sales.
  • Proven work experience with text messaging/emailing in English.
  • You must enjoy being on the phone and speaking to sellers.
  • Excellent communication skills, including listening and facing conflict head-on.
  • Excellent at building rapport.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly grow.
  • Open to learning new processes in cold calling/seller outreach.
  • Self-sufficient and able to properly manage one’s own time.
  • Well-organized and able to maintain a pipeline that the Refunds Coordinator and sales Manager can observe and understand.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Experience as a real estate investor is preferred but optional.
  • Must pass written and verbal exams.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Company Description

Scandinavian Capital Markets is a foreign currency broker based in Stockholm with a remote workforce. We are building the next generation of currency trading technology and products, and we are looking for someone who can work independently and think outside the box. If you are someone who excels at mobile technologies, but also wants to have a voice in high-level decisions such as architecture and product, we want to meet you!

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

title: Template Designer Intern
description:
Na Cape.io, não estamos apenas acompanhando o ritmo da indústria publicitária. Estamos acelerando-o.


Somos uma empresa global de tecnologia com a missão de eliminar o atrito entre o criativo e a mídia. A Cape.io é a primeira plataforma de Automação Inteligente de Campanhas a unificar todo o ciclo de vida de uma campanha. Ao integrar IA e conformidade (compliance) automatizada desde a concepção criativa até a ativação, capacitamos marcas a lançar campanhas de alto impacto e dentro das normas com velocidade e inteligência sem precedentes.


Nossa plataforma conta com a confiança das principais agências e anunciantes do mundo para controlar e distribuir conteúdo publicitário em mais de 100 países. Com mais de 230 funcionários em 21 escritórios — de Londres às Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico — estamos mudando fundamentalmente a forma como a publicidade funciona.


O que você fará

Como Estagiário(a) de Template Design, você ajudará a criar e otimizar templates para clientes. Você participará de projetos de onboarding criativo e auxiliará no treinamento de novos clientes que utilizam nossa ferramenta self-service de Template Designer. Além disso, você será um ponto de contato para suporte e dúvidas técnicas sobre a ferramenta.

Durante seu estágio, você aprenderá:


  • Como construir templates dinâmicos para diversos clientes globais.
  • Como guiar novos clientes através do processo de onboarding criativo.
  • Como fornecer treinamento especializado e suporte técnico sobre nossa ferramenta de design.


O que você traz (Perfil desejado)

  • Formação: Você está cursando ensino superior ou se formou recentemente em áreas correlatas (Design, Publicidade, Marketing,, etc.).
  • Experiência em Design: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Photoshop, InDesign, Figma ou softwares similares.
  • Familiarizado com Automação: Você gosta de otimizar processos e torná-los mais eficientes através da tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Você gosta de interagir com pessoas, dar treinamentos e solucionar dúvidas de clientes.
  • Idiomas: Português nativo e proficiência em Inglês e Espanhol.
  • Atenção aos detalhes: Você tem um olhar apurado para design e garante que todos os templates tenham acabamento profissional.
  • Vontade de crescer: Mentalidade curiosa e motivação para desenvolver novas habilidades técnicas e de atendimento ao cliente.


Sobre nossa solução de automação criativa

  • O desafio: Gargalos criativos e operações manuais de Ad Ops geram sobrecarga nas equipes e prejudicam a performance das campanhas. O ciclo infinito de revisões impede que as marcas escalem o que realmente funciona.
  • Nossa solução: Construímos uma plataforma all-in-one para produzir, personalizar e lançar anúncios de alta performance em todos os canais — de redes sociais e display a vídeo e DOOH. Unificamos os fluxos de criação e mídia, permitindo que marcas passem de um único criativo mestre para variações ilimitadas em minutos.
  • Seu impacto: Você estará no coração da nossa missão de libertar a criatividade. Você capacitará nossos clientes a superar a concorrência através de ferramentas que transformam dados em anúncios personalizados de alto impacto em escala.


Nosso DNA: Como trabalhamos

Nossos valores são os princípios que guiam nossas decisões e interações todos os dias:

  • Mova-se com inteligência (Move smart): A hesitação mata o ritmo. Combinamos velocidade com inteligência, transformando desafios complexos em soluções automatizadas.
  • Defina o amanhã (Define tomorrow): Não estamos aqui para atender expectativas, mas para redefini-las. Buscamos qualidade, segurança e escala sem precedentes.
  • Melhores juntos (Be better together): O sucesso se multiplica quando compartilhado. Através da colaboração aberta e apoio mútuo, transformamos potencial individual em conquista coletiva.
  • Mude o que é possível (Change what’s possible): A criatividade impulsiona a humanidade. Nossa tecnologia existe para amplificá-la e permitir que ela decole.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)

As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

title: Mainframe System Engineer
description:
Mainframe System Engineer

Location – Brazil Remote



Job Overview:


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Mandatory Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:
  • IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
  • IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
  • IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
  • IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)
  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems
  • CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
  • CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
  • IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation, operational considerations).
  • CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.
