title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior – Oracle Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Must Haves

  • 1+ year of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python or Java development experience, including API development, model training, testing, and general backend engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ingestion workflows, or ETL processes
  • Experience evaluating the quality of Search or Generative AI systems
  • Strong communication skills; able to work independently while providing clear, consistent updates to the team
  • Collaborative team player who is proactive in sharing knowledge and contributing to team best practices

Plusses

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience using LangChain to build LLM workflows with tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other Lucene-based search technologies
  • Experience with Airflow
  • Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures


Day to Day

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (one Mid-Level and one Senior) to join a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and quality engineers. In this role, you will contribute to an enterprise-grade, end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Responsibilities span the full lifecycle, including content ingestion and pipeline development, indexing and retrieval quality improvements, answer generation, and system evaluation. You will work on experimentation, model development, ETL workflows, search relevance, and evaluation frameworks. The role includes deploying code to non-production environments and supporting production releases in collaboration with the DevOps team. This is primarily a hands-on individual contributor role, with an expectation of clear communication, collaboration, and active participation in team discussions and planning.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.

title: Senior Executive Assistant | Senior Virtual Assistant
description:
Saleslights | Full-Time | Remote (Brazil Only)


Salary: 3,700 BRL/ month


Saleslights is looking for a bright, enthusiastic, vibrant, and highly organized Senior Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant to work directly with ambitious founders and senior sales leaders in the United States.

The ideal candidate is already active on LinkedIn , enjoys building their own professional brand, and is interested in sales, marketing, technology, and social selling .


You may already be posting insights, engaging with business content, or participating in conversations around:

• B2B sales

• marketing strategy

• technology

• entrepreneurship


A background in sales and marketing is highly valued for this role.


Additionally, the ideal candidate is a passionate and skilled video editor who enjoys producing their own short-form social media videos and understands the dynamics of modern vertical video content.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with driven founders and elite sales professionals and thrives in a professional, fast-moving environment.


Overview:

Saleslights works with ambitious founders in the United States to help them build visibility, credibility, and authority through strategic communication and founder-led content.


Our clients are typically:

• cybersecurity founders

• B2B SaaS founders

• high-growth service company CEOs


They are visionary operators who move quickly and think strategically.

They do not need task managers.

They need someone who can manage communication, momentum, and execution around them.

Your role is to become the trusted operational partner for a small group of founders and senior / elite salespeople.


Your Mission:

You will manage up to three US founders or senior sales professionals and ensure they consistently complete a small number of high-impact activities each month.


Your job is to:

• organize communication

• keep projects moving

• motivate founder or sales leader participation

• maintain professional correspondence

• ensure key deliverables are completed


This role is closer to a Chief-of-Staff / Executive Assistant hybrid than a typical VA role.


Core Responsibilities:

You will manage the following for each founder or senior sales professional.


Founder Communication

Primary communication channel via email.


You will:

• write thoughtful, professional emails

• summarize discussions clearly

• guide founders or sales leaders toward next steps

• keep communication structured and calm

Expect to write long-form strategic emails , not quick chat replies.


Founder Momentum


Each month you will ensure founders or senior sales professionals complete:

• 2 short video recordings

• 5 document approvals

• up to 4 meetings


Your role is to:

• schedule

• follow up

• motivate

• remove friction

This requires strong soft leadership and persuasion skills .


Project Organization


You will maintain simple project tracking for each founder or sales leader.


Responsibilities include:

• organizing deliverables

• tracking approvals

• maintaining timelines

• ensuring no work stalls

You will operate similarly to a lightweight project manager .


Relationship Management


You will be the primary point of coordination between:

• the founder or sales leader

• the Saleslights internal team


You must maintain:

• professionalism

• calm communication

• clarity under pressure


What This Role Is Not

This is not a typical VA task role .

It is not:

• data entry

• admin errands

• simple task execution


This role requires someone comfortable working with driven founders, executives, and senior sales professionals from the US and Europe .

You must be comfortable with:

• fast-moving conversations

• high expectations

• strategic discussions


Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who has previously worked as:

• Executive Assistant to a CEO

• Chief of Staff style operator

• Agency Account Manager

• Founder or sales leader support operator


Key traits:

• extremely organized

• confident communicator

• calm under pressure

• professional writing ability

• proactive and responsible

You should enjoy working with high-performance personalities .


Work Structure

Each operator manages up to three founders or senior sales professionals .

Typical monthly workload per client:

• 2 videos coordinated

• 5 approvals managed

• 4 meetings maximum

This is a relationship and communication management role , not heavy operational labor.


Compensation


Salary: 3,700 BRL / month

Full-time role.

Because this is a high-trust position supporting founders and senior sales professionals directly:

outside client work is not permitted.


Why This Role Is Unique

You will work directly with founders and senior sales professionals building companies in:

• cybersecurity

• B2B technology

• high-growth services


You will gain exposure to:

• strategy discussions

• founder decision making

  • international business operations

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Operações – Issuance (Jr) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Apoiar na criação e atualização de materiais de treinamento e documentação técnica;
  • Atendimento a projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Monitoração de ambientes através do Zabbiz e Grafana;
  • Participar de chamadas com clientes nacionais e internacionais para implantação de projetos, inicialmente com acompanhamento e evoluindo para condução conforme ganho de experiência;
  • Participar de reuniões de treinamento e/ou alinhamento da solução com clientes, fabricantes e parceiros;
  • Abertura de demandas técnicas para os times internos;
  • Apoiar na instalação da solução e nas atualizações dos ambientes de homologação e produção, seguindo procedimentos definidos e com acompanhamento do time mais experiente;
  • Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar implementação de projetos, garantindo histórico claro, comunicação adequada e cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Manter comunicação clara e contínua com os clientes durante o ciclo de vida do projeto, informando status, próximos passos e orientações.

  • Formação superior completa na área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência na área suporte/operações em atendimento ao cliente externo - nacional ou internacional;
  • Experiencia atuando em ambiente de trabalho na área de softwares com atividades de configuração, manutenção e treinamento de clientes;
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em troubleshooting e análise de logs;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em redes e protocolos de segurança;
  • Conhecimentos nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Disponibilidade de atuar esporádicas vezes (uma vez a cada 30 ou 45 dias) presencialmente na sede da empresa, em Campinas/SP.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;
  • Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte e projetos, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets;
  • Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros);
  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

title: Moderador de Contéudo Trilingue
description:
Adecco, líder mundial de soluções de RH, está presente em 60 países, com mais de 5.500 filiais em que trabalham mais de 30.000 pessoas, em parceria com mais de 100.000 empresas clientes, distribuídas por todo o mundo. Oferecemos uma ampla variedade de serviços voltados para Recursos Humanos.


Assessoramos importante plataforma de mídia social multinacional que busca um Moderador de Conteúdo!


Nossa equipe de Search Operations apoia nossos esforços para lidar com conteúdos questionáveis ou perturbadores, que podem incluir imagens de violência, crueldade contra animais, discurso de ódio, extremismo violento ou conteúdos que explorem ou coloquem crianças em risco. A equipe desempenha um papel fundamental na análise de pesquisas dos usuários e na otimização das estratégias de busca, garantindo uma experiência positiva e segura para nossa comunidade.

O conteúdo com o qual a posição interage inclui imagens, vídeos e textos relacionados à vida cotidiana, mas também pode incluir (entre outros): bullying; discurso de ódio; segurança infantil; representações de danos a si mesmo e a outras pessoas; e maus-tratos a animais.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar inspeção de qualidade de diversos conjuntos de dados e projetos, garantindo que atendam aos requisitos do projeto e mantendo a entrega pontual dos casos de QA.
  • Demonstrar julgamento excepcional na resolução de casos ambíguos e fornecer feedbacks oportunos, identificando riscos potenciais e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Priorizar a qualidade, a segurança e a integridade do conteúdo, monitorar de perto o progresso do negócio e contribuir para iterações de otimização das funcionalidades do produto.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para otimizar políticas relevantes e procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs), apoiando processos de treinamento e esclarecimento para garantir entendimento preciso e entrega adequada dos dados.
  • Facilitar reuniões de calibração com as equipes envolvidas durante processos de apelação, analisar casos, oferecer soluções e sugestões para melhorar o desempenho, a precisão e o alinhamento da equipe com as metas do projeto.
  • Realizar a entrega de dados para métricas do projeto, fornecendo análise de dados, análise de causa raiz (RCA) e planos de ação durante reuniões de revisão de desempenho do projeto e revisões de negócio (WBRs, QBRs, etc.).
  • Assumir responsabilidades adicionais compatíveis e relacionadas conforme exigido pelo projeto, incluindo, mas não se limitando a: localização de políticas, suporte a treinamentos internos e externos, inspeção de dados, reuniões de calibração e avaliação de estratégias.


Qualificações

Requisitos mínimos

  • Proficiência em espanhol é obrigatória para colaborar com parceiros globais, incluindo equipes multifuncionais localizadas em regiões de língua espanhola. Essas interações incluem liderar e participar de reuniões conduzidas em espanhol, bem como comunicação por chat ou e-mail.
  • Conhecimento sobre mecanismos de busca e familiaridade com plataformas de redes sociais.
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em projetos fora da área principal de especialização quando necessário e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos variáveis, incluindo fins de semana, noites e madrugadas, garantindo disponibilidade em cinco de cada sete dias da semana.
  • Disposição para trabalhar com conteúdos sensíveis e potencialmente perturbadores.


Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência em QA, moderação, anotação de IA ou equivalente, conhecimento de mercado, entendimento da cultura local e dos hábitos de uso da internet dos mercados-alvo.
  • Familiaridade com negócios relacionados a compras online e tendências de busca é desejável.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas, incluindo análise de dados, capacidade de aprendizado, resolução de problemas, adaptabilidade e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proficiência em softwares comuns de produtividade (ex.: Office Suite, Google Workspace, etc.).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz com equipes multifuncionais e stakeholders em diferentes localidades e fusos horários.

title: PLM Architect
description:
About us :

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Responsibilities

  • You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • You will analyze customers’ business requirements and successfully implement solutions as part of a cross-functional team.
  • You will lead and/or participate in, assist with, or act as the facilitator in workshops/work sessions.
  • You will support the definition of client-specific solutions for PLM, including application and technical architecture.
  • You will help our customers realize value faster by optimizing OOTB solutions and redefining processes, as needed.
  • You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing.
  • You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support.
  • You will ensure quality through established software engineering methods and processes.
  • You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders.
  • You will manage commitments within a flexible work schedule.

Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Strong PLM domain knowledge
  • Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Knowledge of PTC Windchill Product suites desired.
  • Be able to work autonomously and focus on goals.
  • Be customer service oriented.
  • Have programming skills, preferably in Java.
  • A desire to continue your professional growth through formal and on-the-job ongoing product and consulting skills training.

Must Have Skills

  • 5-10+ years’ experience in PLM, preferably PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • Participated in PLM Implementation projects.
  • Educational background in Engineering or Computer Science (bachelor’s or master’s Degree Level)
  • Languages: Advanced or Fluent Proficiency level (written and spoken) in English and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel, as needed

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. title: [Tech] Especialista em Desenvolvimento Full Stack - .Net
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você terá a oportunidade de impactar diretamente o setor RH. Buscamos um(a) Especialista Full Stack com foco em IA com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que será responsável pela gestão e operação de um Consultor digital, atuando como ponto focal para iniciativas de experimentação e aplicação de tecnologias de IA. Este profissional terá como missão fomentar a cultura de IA, promover o uso ético e estratégico da IA, e apoiar colaboradores e equipes na exploração de soluções inteligentes que agreguem valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Propor soluções conceituais e orientar a implementação de projetos de IA;
  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural e/ou Visão Computacional;
  • Familiaridade com as capacidades e limitações da IA Generativa (ex: LLMs);
  • Integração de modelos de linguagem (LLMs) com APIs e sistemas legados;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e suas aplicações em negócios;
  • Integrar soluções de IA a sistemas corporativos de ERP, atuando no desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Visão sistêmica: entender impactos das decisões técnicas no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas;
  • Orientar e atuar junto ao time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio e arquitetura, por meio de pesquisas e trocas de conhecimento com áreas parceiras.Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Boa lógica de programação e princípios SOLID;
  • Conhecimento em Back-end (c#, .Net, Advpl);
  • Conhecimento em Front-end (Angular/TypeScript);
  • Graduação completa em Computação, Engenharia, Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de IA/ML (NLP, LLMs, classificação e extração de entidades) e capacidade analítica para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de IA;
  • Engenharia de prompts, MCP, RAG, pipelines, modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados;
  • Experiência com projetos de IA Generativa;
  • Banco de Dados: SQL e NoSQL;
  • Controle de Versão: Git e ferramentas associadas (Repos, GitHub, GitLab);
  • APIs e configuração e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Noções de segurança da informação e boas práticas para desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Conhecimento em Processo Ágil, DevOps e plataformas Cloud (Azure).


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em PO-UI.

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: Business Analyst - 100% Remote
description:
At Cibernos , we are looking for talent to work with a company in the software and cybersecurity sector , specializing in digital brand protection, corporate domain portfolio management, and securing the online presence of global organizations.

We are seeking a Business Analyst who will act as the link between business stakeholders, the Product Owner, and engineering teams to support the delivery of high-quality SaaS solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business and functional requirements.
  • Translate business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria .
  • Work closely with the Product Owner to refine the product backlog .
  • Facilitate communication between stakeholders and engineering teams.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and validate that delivered solutions meet business requirements.


Requirements

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $4,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Trading Systems to focus on the architecture, optimization, and development of their high-performance managed account platform. In this role, you will work on the computational core of the platform, designing and maintaining scalable backend services that power portfolio management and trading systems.


This position requires strong backend engineering and architectural expertise to translate complex business logic into efficient, production-grade code primarily using Python and C#/.NET Core. The ideal candidate excels at diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and building reliable systems through rigorous code and systems analysis.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement core platform logic, including high-throughput rebalancing and data processing services, using Python and C#/.NET Core.
  • Translate high-level functional requirements into clean, efficient, and testable backend code and microservices.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and reliability issues by analyzing system architecture, algorithmic complexity, and code efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate core services into production-grade microservices and serverless workflows.
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs that serve financial calculations and portfolio analytics.
  • Conduct code reviews focusing on architecture, correctness, efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Profile and optimize backend services to ensure sub-second response times for compute-intensive operations.
  • Write clear technical documentation in Confluence to explain complex system logic to cross-functional teams.
  • Implement serverless and scalable solutions using AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, and ECS, with a strong preference for Python-based implementations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with product owners to align technical solutions with business needs.


Requirements for Success:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with significant experience in both C#/.NET Core and Python.
  • 4+ years working with relational databases, preferably SQL Server, including advanced query and schema optimization.
  • 4+ years developing cloud-native applications, preferably using AWS.
  • Proven experience as a senior backend engineer, driving design and best practices across multiple systems.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity.
  • Familiarity with financial concepts such as rebalancing, asset allocation, and trade execution.
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve performance issues through code profiling and optimization techniques.


Skills We Are Looking For:

  • Backend Engineering & Architecture:  C#, .NET Core, Python, serverless architectures, microservices architecture, and system design.
  • Problem Diagnosis:  Strong ability to identify system bottlenecks, analyze code efficiency, and clearly communicate technical problems.
  • Cloud Platforms:  Experience with AWS services, including Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, S3, and DynamoDB.
  • Database Proficiency:  Strong experience with SQL Server optimization and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • API Development:  Experience building RESTful web services, JSON APIs, and working with OpenAPI specifications.
  • Code Quality:  Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and continuous integration practices.
  • Communication:  Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts.
  • Collaboration:  Ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.


Bonus Items:

  • Experience with quantitative models for portfolio construction and optimization.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration.
  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect or Developer.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic.
  • Background in wealth management or FinTech systems.
  • Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build high-performance trading systems at a leading fintech platform.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


  • *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação com time Global.
  • Experiência com Experience Cloud .
  • Ter experiência em desenvolvimento e customização na plataforma Salesforce (Salesforce CRM, Lightning, Apex, Visualforce, Aura e LWC), seguindo boas práticas de governança e arquitetura.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento (análise, implementação, testes, implantação, suporte e manutenção) da instância Salesforce.
  • Realizar codificação e integrações utilizando Apex, SOQL, SOSL e APIs REST, bem como ferramentas como Data Loader, Postman e recursos OOB (out of the box) do Salesforce.
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em tecnologias web (JavaScript, HTML5 e CSS).
  • Utilizar controle de versionamento (Git/Bitbucket).
  • Colaborar com usuários-chave, arquitetos e consultores de negócio, realizando demonstrações e garantindo aderência aos requisitos funcionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, protótipos, fluxogramas, diagramas de sequência e planos de testes, assegurando qualidade e conformidade das entregas.
  • Realizar revisão de código e aplicar padrões consolidados de desenvolvimento (OOP, MVC/MVCS, Domain Layer Principle).


Diferenciais:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente.
  • Ter experiência com Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como: Platform Developer I, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, Administrator, JavaScript Developer I, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce - Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 57333


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação com time Global.
  • Experiência com Experience Cloud .
  • Ter experiência em desenvolvimento e customização na plataforma Salesforce (Salesforce CRM, Lightning, Apex, Visualforce, Aura e LWC), seguindo boas práticas de governança e arquitetura.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento (análise, implementação, testes, implantação, suporte e manutenção) da instância Salesforce.

title: Senior Executive Assistant | Senior Virtual Assistant
description:
Saleslights | Full-Time | Remote (Brazil Only)


Salary: 3,700 BRL/ month


Saleslights is looking for a bright, enthusiastic, vibrant, and highly organized Senior Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant to work directly with ambitious founders and senior sales leaders in the United States.

The ideal candidate is already active on LinkedIn , enjoys building their own professional brand, and is interested in sales, marketing, technology, and social selling .


You may already be posting insights, engaging with business content, or participating in conversations around:

• B2B sales

• marketing strategy

• technology

• entrepreneurship


A background in sales and marketing is highly valued for this role.


Additionally, the ideal candidate is a passionate and skilled video editor who enjoys producing their own short-form social media videos and understands the dynamics of modern vertical video content.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with driven founders and elite sales professionals and thrives in a professional, fast-moving environment.


Overview:

Saleslights works with ambitious founders in the United States to help them build visibility, credibility, and authority through strategic communication and founder-led content.


Our clients are typically:

• cybersecurity founders

• B2B SaaS founders

• high-growth service company CEOs


They are visionary operators who move quickly and think strategically.

They do not need task managers.

They need someone who can manage communication, momentum, and execution around them.

Your role is to become the trusted operational partner for a small group of founders and senior / elite salespeople.


Your Mission:

You will manage up to three US founders or senior sales professionals and ensure they consistently complete a small number of high-impact activities each month.


Your job is to:

• organize communication

• keep projects moving

• motivate founder or sales leader participation

• maintain professional correspondence

• ensure key deliverables are completed


This role is closer to a Chief-of-Staff / Executive Assistant hybrid than a typical VA role.


Core Responsibilities:

You will manage the following for each founder or senior sales professional.


Founder Communication

Primary communication channel via email.


You will:

• write thoughtful, professional emails

• summarize discussions clearly

• guide founders or sales leaders toward next steps

• keep communication structured and calm

Expect to write long-form strategic emails , not quick chat replies.


Founder Momentum


Each month you will ensure founders or senior sales professionals complete:

• 2 short video recordings

• 5 document approvals

• up to 4 meetings


Your role is to:

• schedule

• follow up

• motivate

• remove friction

This requires strong soft leadership and persuasion skills .


Project Organization


You will maintain simple project tracking for each founder or sales leader.


Responsibilities include:

• organizing deliverables

• tracking approvals

• maintaining timelines

• ensuring no work stalls

You will operate similarly to a lightweight project manager .


Relationship Management


You will be the primary point of coordination between:

• the founder or sales leader

• the Saleslights internal team


You must maintain:

• professionalism

• calm communication

• clarity under pressure


What This Role Is Not

This is not a typical VA task role .

It is not:

• data entry

• admin errands

• simple task execution


This role requires someone comfortable working with driven founders, executives, and senior sales professionals from the US and Europe .

You must be comfortable with:

• fast-moving conversations

• high expectations

• strategic discussions


Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who has previously worked as:

• Executive Assistant to a CEO

• Chief of Staff style operator

• Agency Account Manager

• Founder or sales leader support operator


Key traits:

• extremely organized

• confident communicator

• calm under pressure

• professional writing ability

• proactive and responsible

You should enjoy working with high-performance personalities .


Work Structure

Each operator manages up to three founders or senior sales professionals .

Typical monthly workload per client:

• 2 videos coordinated

• 5 approvals managed

• 4 meetings maximum

This is a relationship and communication management role , not heavy operational labor.


Compensation


Salary: 3,700 BRL / month

Full-time role.

Because this is a high-trust position supporting founders and senior sales professionals directly:

outside client work is not permitted.


Why This Role Is Unique

You will work directly with founders and senior sales professionals building companies in:

• cybersecurity

• B2B technology

• high-growth services


You will gain exposure to:

• strategy discussions

• founder decision making

  • international business operations

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!
